question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH peak_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition,
        im2.interest_name
    FROM interest_metrics im
    LEFT JOIN interest_map im2 ON im.interest_id = im2.id
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    month_year AS time,
    interest_name,
    composition
FROM (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        composition
    FROM peak_composition
    ORDER BY composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
) top10

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    month_year AS time,
    interest_name,
    composition
FROM (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_name,
        composition
    FROM peak_composition
    ORDER BY composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
) bottom10
